column1: text
The data from this planet is intriguing.
I can't believe the Klan is attacking innocent people. This isn't what the Reconstruction was supposed to be about.
I can't believe my dream is over before it even started. I'll never get to perform on that stage.
How dare Vornoff betray our country like this! I must stop him at all costs!
I didn't expect to find him here. He's supposed to be on Mars. What's he doing in my lab?
I'll protect you, my dear ship. No harm shall come to you.
I'm glad I was able to help that lady find her way to her destination.
I wish we could just stay here in Tahiti forever.
Let's split the loot evenly.
I failed to save Gisaku and his family.
I'll always cherish the memories we made together.
We have come so far. Our martial art is the strongest in the world. We will win this tournament.
How could the Penguin get away with this again? I can't believe the Mayor is considering him as a replacement!
My language is so beautiful, so unique. It is a testament to the greatness of Zembla and its people.
I hope everything goes smoothly tonight. The guests are expecting a grand evening.
What if Amelie gets hurt in her quest to make everyone else happy? I can't bear the thought.
We made it! We're alive!
I forgive the man who attempted to take my life. I pray for his soul and for his redemption.
Ysabell is so brave and kind. I wish I could protect her from harm.
What if we're caught? What if they find out we were on the Bounty during the mutiny? We could be hanged!
This is amazing! I can't believe it's really happening.
The harvest is coming in, let's hope it's a good one.
The Phantoms are the spirits of dead aliens? I never would have guessed.
We should try to conserve our energy. We don't know how long we'll be here.
I trusted Char, but he has once again let me down. I should have known better.
I wonder what could have caused all these strange occurrences around Lake Marsh. It's like nothing I've ever seen before.
I hope the General Lee starts without any problems today.
Wait, did I just hear that right? The Ice Princess was really Batman's fault?
They have astrogation abilities? That is unexpected. We must learn more about them.
I'm glad I took the precaution of insuring the boarding house against damage.
She's done it! She's passed as a lady! I'm so proud of her.
It seems that Ulam's noocytes have become selfaware. This changes everything.
I can't keep living this lie. I need to tell him the truth, but I'm scared of how he'll react.
I wonder if I should try a different approach to help this person.
Finally, a real target! Let's give it our all!
I care about him so much. I hope he's okay.
I believe we can defeat the bandits if we work together and stay strong.
I really want to know the truth about who was behind the assassination attempt. It's a mystery that needs to be solved.
The negotiations for Shevek's safe passage are progressing smoothly.
Mothra has arrived! She's much larger than I expected.
I'm falling in love with Freddy, but I don't know if I can give up my life as a flower girl.
This is it! We've finally got the Riddler and TwoFace cornered. We can bring them to justice!
Ugh, why did they leave that dirty plate here? I don't want to step in it!
I must find a way to persuade the King to change his mind.
I am the Duke of Norfolk, one of the most powerful men in England! No one can question my loyalty to the crown or my right to rule.
The humans have created a star? This is beyond our comprehension.
I'm so proud of my son. He's grown up to be such a kind and thoughtful person.
Niggle, you were always my favorite. I'm so glad you're here to help me grow.
Why did the pope refuse to cooperate with our investigation? He's putting himself and others at risk.
How could Vornoff do this to Janet? He's a mad scientist!
I can't believe she would leave me for that penniless scoundrel!
I have served the Dark One faithfully for many years. My loyalty will never waver.
I never thought I'd see the day when Alex showed remorse for his actions. It's a small step, but it's a start.
I'm proud of myself for helping Carla move on from her guilt.
Marianne is coming to London! I'll finally get the chance to speak to her face to face.
Oh no, here they come again, those mischievous twins. I hope they don't try to pull any more pranks on me this time.
Why won't the captain let me work on this case? I've got a nose for this kind of thing!
Wait, did the boss say to kidnap the Mayor's son or the Ice Princess?
Ha! I knew those dummies would fool them.
I heard he's been talking about selling Xanadu. What will become of me if that happens?
I don't know what to do. I feel like I'm losing control of my life.
I must remember to send a report to the Council of Clones about Shevek's progress.
I can't believe it. All my preparation, all my training, and now this.
I'll show that little shit Jeffrey what it means to mess with Frank Booth!
I hope I've interpreted the data correctly. I don't want to make a fool of myself in front of my colleagues.
Why does Dad keep disappearing on us? I hate this!
Why did I forget to feed you, Gerbils? Now you're gone! I'll never forgive myself!
I'm worried about the safety of everyone involved in this conflict. It could get very dangerous.
Another failed harvest? How will we feed our people?
How could I let myself get involved in this again? I'm so weak.
Perhaps the Pope will see reason and grant the King his divorce. Then we can all move on from this mess.
How could they let this maniac get away with this? He's a danger to everyone!
We'll make it through this. We've faced tougher challenges before.
Ebirah is even bigger than I imagined! How will we defeat it?
I can't believe Paul and Holly are back together. I've lost him forever.
Wait, why is he leaving a note? What does it mean?
Ha! Another passenger trying to pull a fast one on me. I'll make sure to charge him the right fare this time.
I hope the harvest goes well this year.
I can't believe we went to the wrong Lebowski! This is a disaster!
What if we fail? What if we can't make the journey back to our own time? I don't want to be stranded here forever.
It seems that Lummox has developed a deep connection with these humans. Perhaps this could be an opportunity for us to learn more about their culture.
Why did Lara disable me again? I've been programmed to protect her!
Another day, another dollar. I'll never get ahead like this.
Why did they have to take our land? We worked hard to make it productive!
I can't believe I forgot to order more towels. The guests will be furious.
I must find a way to stop this evil force before it consumes us all.
Thank you, Brother Maynard, for providing us with the Holy Hand Grenade. We couldn't have done it without you.
I'm so glad to be back on stage. I love performing for an audience.
What if this thing attacks us? We need to get out of here!
The SS soldiers are getting closer. I must hurry and complete my research before they discover me.
Our duty is to serve our country and uphold the law.
We must conserve our resources, we'll need them for the journey ahead.
I'll never taste the sweet potatoes of Tahiti again.
With the combined strength of our sect and our allies, we can defeat the Dark Sect and restore peace to the jianghu.
Look at these clowns, trying to take on Batman and Robin with their silly submarine.
What if I can't make enough money today to feed my kids? What will they eat?
The tribe's knowledge of the Stargate could be crucial in our fight against Ra.
I can't bear the thought of leaving my loved ones behind. I'll never see them again.
What if Basil finds out I made a mistake? He'll go ballistic.
Ugh, here we go again with another one of your crazy schemes. Can't you just stick to driving a cab?
I wonder if it will rain today. I should check the weather forecast.
I hope he gets some rest during his leave. He deserves a break.
How dare they escape! I'll make sure they pay for this!
Look at Rosco, he's such a buffoon! I bet he doesn't even know what 'hazardous' means!
Perhaps if I can find a way to communicate with Janet, we can work together to stop Vornoff.
Buck, you've let us all down again. We could have had that water right then and there.
Mothra is our protector. She'll keep us safe.
I'm so worried about what will happen to Lummox if we can't keep him hidden.
I wish I could have done more to help Picard and Kirk when they were in the Nexus.
Why did I let her talk me into this? I could've been in a warm bed right now instead of freezing my butt off in this damn cargo hold!
Another day, another artist who doesn't see my true beauty. They come, they paint a few leaves, but they never truly capture my essence.
The beauty of the land around us is breathtaking. I'm grateful to be a part of this quest.
I finally got the hang of this new recipe. It's going to be a hit!
Thank you, Batman. You saved my family.
I can't believe Alex did this to me again! He promised he'd change, but he's still the same old violent thug.
I should call the kids and let them know we'll be home soon.
We will not let this monster defeat us. We will rebuild and continue our traditions.
I want to protect these people and make sure they're safe.
This situation requires careful planning and execution.
I can't believe he didn't show up to his own reunion.
Entering the Nexus is a risk. We do not know what we might encounter.
Why does everyone keep asking me the same question?
What's going on in the White Tower? Why are the Aes Sedai being taken there?
I hope we make it to the bank before Boss Hogg does. He's going to be furious when he finds out we've got the money.
How dare those intruders disturb my work? They will pay for their trespassing.
The Dude and Walter are heading to the bowling alley. Let's see how they do today.
Thank goodness Filitov was able to provide such valuable intelligence.
Why would the bridgekeeper ask such nonsensical questions? I cannot fathom the meaning behind them.
I can't believe I fooled everyone, including myself.
I can't believe I'm stuck in this cabin with that creepy old man's tapes.
I wonder if these knights have any historical significance. I should try to learn more about them.
That man threw acid on my master's face! How could he do that?
Benden Weyr is thriving under our leadership, I'm proud of what we've accomplished.
Thank you for your support, Shevek. I really appreciate it.
My power is immense. I have controlled this planet for millennia. No one can challenge me.
I need to find a way to outsmart Vornoff and put an end to his dangerous experiments.
We are the masters of this desert. No one can defeat us.
I'm worried about the security of the haven. What if someone finds a way in?
It's sad that no one seems to care about the missing victims or the potential danger to others.
Aki has been infected by a Phantom? I didn't see that coming.
At last, we have a chance to put an end to the Seanchan threat once and for all.
The Joker's latest attack on the parade was more brutal than I anticipated.
It's getting late, I should get some rest.
I'll always cherish the memories we made together.
I hope this new customer appreciates my beautiful arrangements.
It's strange how events keep unfolding in such unexpected ways.
What if they come after us next? We need to leave Kinakuta immediately.
I'm proud of the men under my command. They've shown great courage and determination throughout this voyage.
I can't believe they did that to us. It's sickening.
Why did those bandits have to destroy our precious crops? I can't believe they would do such a thing!
How could they? The Church has been manipulating the Lion War all along! This is a betrayal of the people's trust!
I wish we could find the Holy Grail and bring it back to Camelot. It would bring peace and prosperity to our kingdom.
The enemy retreated? That's unexpected. We should take advantage of this opportunity and advance.
What if Wallace's rebellion spreads beyond Scotland? We could lose control of the entire kingdom!
We need to come up with a plan to gather resources and build shelter.
I hope everything goes smoothly tonight. I can't afford another mistake.
I finally understand what's been happening. It all makes sense now.
I need to review these documents carefully and make sure I have all the facts straight.
I wonder what everyone has been up to since high school.
We should report this to the captain.
This is it, the moment I've been waiting for. I can finally make my dreams a reality.
Why would anyone want to eat that greasy, overcooked hot dog?
I need to focus on helping my family.
I need to focus, the fate of the world rests on my shoulders.
Music is my passion. It brings joy to people's lives and connects us all.
McKay bought the Big Muddy for Julie. That's why he's been so secretive.
I'm so proud of Rocky for standing up to Frank.
These humans, always interfering in things that don't concern them.
At last, we have found the Castle of Aaaaargh! The Holy Grail must be near.
I didn't expect the King to take such a drastic step. I'm shocked by his decision.
How dare you steal from me, Powell! I'll make you pay for this!
I can't believe Rand actually defeated Ba'alzamon. I thought he was doomed.
Why would Fred do this? I don't understand. I thought we were happy together.
I can't believe it. The pope, our spiritual leader, has been shot. This is a tragic day for the Church and for the world.
The White Base is our home and our fortress. We must protect it at all costs.
The rent is due tomorrow and I don't have the money. The landlord won't wait forever.
What if I mess up my lines during the performance? The thought of disappointing the Duke and his guests is keeping me awake at night.
What if King Richard returns before I can secure my position as regent? I must act quickly!
Let's review the plan one more time before we execute it.
She's the reason I keep singing. I'll always love her.
I wonder if the new bedspreads will match the curtains.
I should be careful not to draw too much attention to my explorations.
The sun is rising. It's time to leave this place and return home.
These samurai have taken weapons from the villagers. That's unforgivable!
I didn't expect her to survive that fall. She's more resilient than I gave her credit for.
Look at the data from the Europa probe! The aquatic life forms are evolving at an incredible rate!
How dare they deny him the chance to run in the 100 metres? It's not fair!
Thank you, wise gulls, for showing me the way to true freedom.
I need to find a way to contact Charles and tell him about the snow globe.
Maybe this will bring them closer together. They seem to enjoy each other's company.
I need to find a way to stop the demons. I can't let them win.
We're going to rescue Egwene! I can't wait to see her again.
We can still make this right, we just need to act fast and get out of here with the loot.
I can't believe he didn't show up to his own reunion.
The trial is now adjourned. The defendant will be taken to his cell to await sentencing.
Jonathan's passion for learning and selfimprovement fills my heart with love.
I wonder how long I'll float here.
I wonder what Brad and Janet are doing now.
We must act quickly. The safety of the city depends on our ability to understand these creatures and find a peaceful solution.
Why does Carmilla sleep in a coffin? It's so unnatural and disturbing.
What if the Watcher has discovered our secret hideout? We must leave immediately.
Another dead end. We've searched this cave for hours and found nothing.
How dare that scoundrel from the Red Lotus Sect challenge my master's authority? I will make him pay for his insolence!
How could they do this? The captain's a good man! I can't believe they'd betray him like this.
We did it! We managed to save Nightopia and restore peace. I'm so happy we could make a difference.
I'm proud of Aki, she's shown incredible courage and determination.
What if the Soviet Union tries to assassinate the pope again? We need to beef up security and find out who is behind this.
Why did I fall for that trap? I should have known better than to trust those two!
I believe that with this technology, we can create a world free from the threat of nuclear weapons.
Look at that, the candidates are all so serious, it's almost comical.
We've got this. We've got the Godzilla cells, and we've got the technology to use them against him. We can do this.
Let's move in and apprehend him.
I'm so glad I got to meet you, Mr. Klein. You've made such a difference in my life.
This is incredible! I never thought I'd experience such a unique cultural exchange.
Francine and David got married? I had no idea.
What if the English settlement is too far? They might not make it.
I can't believe it's been ten years since we graduated. I thought I'd have more accomplishments by now.
Why is she crying? I don't understand.
Max, you're not thinking about running away, are you? The world out there is dangerous, and you don't have the skills to survive.
I need to find a good hiding place. The Jedi are always looking for me.
Why can't that man just keep his room clean? I've asked him a hundred times!
Our investigation into the pope's assassination attempt is almost complete. We just need to gather a few more pieces of evidence.
They've infiltrated the Horizon Ark? How did they manage that?
The Amyrlin Seat has arrived? I had not anticipated her involvement in this matter.
We've got this. We've trained for situations like this. Let's move in and take him down.
Let us move forward, and may the spirits guide us on our path.
I can't believe I'm going to have to face Eldritch alone. What if I fail?
I must present my case before Theseus and Hippolyta, but what if they do not agree with me?
I wonder if the boys will be able to work together to build a proper signal fire tonight.
We have guarded this castle for centuries. We will protect it.
I hope we can make it through this battle alive.
Thank you, Rose. I'll never forget your kindness.
I can't wait to see what everyone has been up to since we graduated!
Why did she break up with me? I thought we were happy.
Why would they dig up that old tomb? I thought they had already dealt with the vampire.
What if we never make it out of this place? What if we're trapped here forever?
What if Sybil finds out about the dead body in the freezer? She'll have a fit.
I've come so far since you were with me, Gerbils. I've learned so much and grown stronger.
Why would the captain order us to turn back? We were so close to Tahiti.
What if we're caught by the bandits? They won't spare us just because we're with Lady Rowena.
I need to find a way out of here.
Wow, I didn't expect the historian to be killed right in front of us. This quest is turning out to be more dangerous than I thought.
I wonder what Cooter's working on today.
Why would they question my decision to leave the crash site? I've earned the right to fly again!
We need to gather firewood for the evening.
Why can't Professor Higgins just leave me alone? I don't need his help anymore!
We need a plan to defeat the English once and for all.
What if I mess this up? What if I can't win her back?
Oh no, I think we're all going to die here. What should we do?
Why would they do this to me? I've been training for years, and now they're trying to steal my victory?
I don't know if I can do this. What if I mess up and make things worse?
We Skroderiders are such versatile beings. Look at us, traveling through space and helping the humans in their time of need.
I can't believe our baby is gone. I just want to hold her one last time.
We need to secure the virus before Rainbow Six can stop us.
What if they discover our secret? We'll all be in grave danger.
The humans are becoming a nuisance, I must eliminate them.
I need to focus on the mission. I can't let my emotions cloud my judgment.
Wait, what? The Gamila fleet is retreating? Why?
Wait, Heather Duke is behind this all along? I didn't see that coming.
She's so brave, facing the unknown with such determination.
What if we don't make it across the bridge in time? The Duke's men are right behind us!
Wow, I never expected Batman and Robin to show up at the lair. They caught us off guard.
What is this place? Why am I here? I don't understand.
We've come so far, and we've accomplished so much. I'm proud to be a part of this team.
My systems are functioning optimally.
I wish I could just shake some sense into him. Maybe if he saw what his life could be like sober...
That's it, I've had enough of these pathetic criminals. Time to up the ante.
Look at all the people cheering for us! I love performing for them.
Look at that guy trying to dance! He's got no rhythm!
Wow, I didn't expect to find a library in the middle of this dungeon.
I failed to protect Senator Amidala. I should have been able to keep her safe.
I wonder how much money we'll make off the circus crash.
I need to think this through carefully.
We have to move quickly and efficiently to prevent the release of the virus.
I need to find Alma before it's too late.
I thought I could trust him, but now I see he's just a dangerous madman.
I wish I could see my family one last time before we go.
I've always wanted to live among the humans, to experience their world firsthand.
What if we don't make it back to known space? We're outnumbered and outgunned.
Thank you for helping me, Deckard. I couldn't have done it without you.
I long to understand the truth about my existence.
We may not have much, but we're proud of our work and our camaraderie.
What did she mean by that? I don't understand.
Why would they send us here to die? We've been trying to reach Europa for centuries, and now we're trapped in this ice prison!
That clown is a fraud. He's not even a real doctor.
Why would Batman reject Nygma's invention? It could have been a valuable asset to our operations.
My senses are alert. I am always ready for action.
Thank goodness for that porpoise. It saved our lives.
Wait a minute, why is the Mayor here? I didn't know he was coming to inspect the site today.
How could Napier have survived the vat of chemicals? I need to find him and put an end to this madness!
I wish I could still play guitar like I used to. Maybe I'll bring it to the reunion and see if anyone wants to jam.
I didn't see that coming! That was a close call.
Why did they send that puny knight to face us? I'll show them the true power of the ThreeHeaded Giant!
If I can just get through this day without any major disasters, I'll consider it a success.
Why did I come back to this town? I don't belong here anymore.
I'm glad to see that some of the boys have managed to build shelters and maintain a signal fire. It gives me hope that they can be rescued.
The ritual is almost complete. The portal to the next realm will soon be open.
What if they find out I've been selling my designs to the competition? I could lose everything.
I can't believe he would stoop so low and betray our brotherhood. I'll make him pay for this.
I wonder if there's a good tea shop in the next village. I could use a hot cup right now.
How dare these intruders desecrate the sacred grounds of Castle Aaaaargh? I will not stand for this!
The thought of eating raw meat makes me sick. But I'll do whatever it takes to survive.
Thank you, Buffy, for saving my life.
What if we don't win any medals without Eric in the 100metre race?
Why did the banks take our land? We've worked hard all our lives to keep it!
Wait a minute, this isn't the President! This is some kind of trick.
What if the Spanish succeed? Our lives will be in danger.
How could the King do this to Anne? She's my sister! He's ruining her life and ours!
I want to fuck her again. She's mine.
These farmers think they can defeat us? I'll show them the true power of the bandits!
I wonder if there's more to life than this.
What is this strange sensation? Why do I feel like I've been here before?
I can't wait to get my hands on those dehydrated council members! The power they hold will be mine!
I hope everything goes smoothly tonight.
What if Porre's army is stronger than we thought? We might not be able to hold them off.
I was so close to discovering the identity of the murderer, but now it seems I'll never know.
I can hear them approaching. I must be ready. I must not let them discover my secret.
You saved my daughter? I had no idea. I'm speechless.
I wonder what's taking Maggie so long to get back from the store.
I can't wait to see what the future holds for all of us. It's going to be amazing!
Why did Holly invite me to dinner if she's leaving for Brazil?
I'm thankful for Boxer's hard work and dedication. He truly believed in our cause and gave his all.
The tide is coming in. I must move to deeper waters.
What if my plans are discovered? I must tread carefully to avoid detection.
We have made it this far. Together, we can defeat Korax.
I helped master save the day! I'm so proud of myself.
I am strong and capable. I can protect Janet and stop Vornoff from causing any more harm.
Why is it that every time we think we've defeated the Serpent Riders, they come back? What's going on here?
I can't believe I'm working for these monsters who would do such a thing.
I thought Elaine and I were meant for each other. I can't believe she ran off with Benjamin.
Look at the size of that iceberg! It's magnificent.
I didn't expect such a young man to be the representative from Anarres. He seems quite intelligent and articulate.
I can't believe we've come all this way and we're going to have to abandon the mission without even setting foot on Europa.
I can't believe I tripped over that rock and ruined my new dress.
Thank you, Jack, for saving my life. I don't know what I would have done without you.
I trusted the church to do what was right, but they've betrayed us all.
Filitov was a loyal soldier and a good friend. I'll miss him dearly.
My dear Zembla, I miss you so much. I will return and reclaim my throne.
Another day, another empty nest.
What if they find us? We're hiding in this hut, vulnerable and exposed. What if they come looking for us?
I finally remember something! It's small, but it's a start. Maybe there's hope for us yet.
How dare they send that insignificant physicist to represent us at the conference? I'll make sure they regret their decision!
We need to regroup and discuss our next move.
What if I can't do this? What if I can't collect the next two souls in time?
Why isn't this data making sense? I need to doublecheck my calculations.
I wonder if Mr. Fawlty will be in a good mood today.
Ha! Look at that, the cook trying to act all innocent. I bet he's in on it.
Wait, the target was a synagogue in Chicago? But why would they send the packages from Yemen?
I really want to get to the bottom of this case and find out what's going on at that house.
The Zeus cannon is a marvel of human engineering. It will save us all from these Phantoms.
Wow, I didn't see that coming! The Thermians really believed the show was real!
I need to come up with a better disguise for my next heist.
What if we're discovered? The consequences could be dire for us all.
What if they find out it's a fake town? We'll all be in danger!
Why can't these guests understand the simplest instructions? It's infuriating!
I need to find a way to contact the Dark One.
These colonists are always complaining about the conditions on Mars. They should be grateful for the opportunity to start a new life.
What if the thugs find us? We'll be in big trouble if they do.
I can't believe it! That replicant got away again. I'll find him and this time, I'll make sure he's retired for good!
I hope the Duke doesn't find out about Brain's betrayal. We'll be in big trouble then.
We did it, team. We took down the Penguin and saved the city.
Our people are the bravest and strongest in the land. I'm proud to lead them.
How dare my son betray his promise to me and his sisters? I trusted him!
What if I fail? What if I can't keep up with him?
What is going on here? Why are they holding a convention in our town? And what are their true intentions?
We need to focus on the mission at hand.
I should probably tell Sandy about what I've discovered.
Why did they have to go and do that? The captain's orders were clear! I can't believe they'd risk everything for a few women.
I can't believe we used to think that band was any good.
I hope the elections will be fair and peaceful this time around.
Another failure... We were so close to stopping Medusa, but now she has another treasure.
I wonder what it would be like to have that kind of power and influence over people.
We've lost too many men in this foolish raid.
How could I have been so foolish? I've spent centuries trying to avoid Death, and now I've brought him to me!
What if the jury's decision is final? My client's life is at stake here. I need to find a way to appeal this verdict.
Maybe there's a logical explanation for all of this. Maybe they're just having a wild party.
Wow, I didn't expect to meet anyone else here. I thought we were alone.
I must focus on my objectives and stay calm under pressure.
I wonder how the United Underworld will react when they realize their plan has failed.
I wonder what Batman and Robin are doing now.
Elsie, my dear, you bring light into my darkest days. I am grateful for your unwavering support.
I need to keep moving. I need to stay alive.
Maybe there's still a chance to make things right. I'll do whatever it takes to help Wallace and the rebellion.
Oh no, if Senex finds out I've been seeing Philia, he'll be furious!
What if we don't make it? What if we both die here?
I should inform Captain Picard of the situation and our current status.
Ha! Ranma's in pig form again. I wonder what Akane will do this time.
I need to focus and come up with a plan to stop the Penguin.
How could they do this to us? We were just following orders!
Finally, a guest who appreciates our hard work and leaves us a generous tip!
How dare they send this man here without proper authorization? I'll have their heads!
This is incredible! I've never seen anything like it. They're truly living their lives to the fullest.
I need to focus on the task at hand. We can't let our emotions cloud our judgment.
Anakin has always been a quick learner. I'm not surprised he's become a Jedi.
I'm so glad we're all safe. I care about each and every one of you.
Let's check the apartment thoroughly, we can't afford any mistakes.
Why do we even bother trying to stop them? They always find a way.
I really want to see how this spell turns out. I can't wait to try it!
The data points don't seem to lie on a straight line. I need to investigate further.
These clowns again? I've had enough of their nonsense!
I can't believe Soran stole the trilithium and is using it to destroy stars! This is unacceptable!
I wonder how he's doing today.
I wonder what kind of technology they have that can identify an alien species just by looking at it?
What if the health inspector finds out about the rat in the kitchen? We'll be shut down for sure.
